title: CellmapFlow
description: What the cellmap-flow dashboard's two backends share: the routes and where each is answered (x-routes), their bodies, the constants both modes use (x-constants) and the chain steps' parameters (x-steps); generated by `python -m cellmap_flow.schema`.

AIAnnotateDecision.description:
The staged annotation to accept or reject; on accept, whether its
labels replace voxels that already have one (``overwrite``) or only
fill unannotated ones.
AIAnnotateDecision.title: AIAnnotateDecision

AIAnnotateResend.description:
The staged annotation to ask the model about again, and the edited
prompt (null or blank: the catalog's).
AIAnnotateResend.title: AIAnnotateResend

AIAnnotateRun.description:
Where to annotate: ``point_nm`` (z, y, x, world nm) in the plane
normal to ``depth_axis`` (0 z: XY, 1 y: XZ, 2 x: YZ). Either may be left
out: the view centre, and the viewer layout's plane.
AIAnnotateRun.title: AIAnnotateRun

AIAnnotateSettings.description:
The provider and model to use (ids the config lists), the target, as
an organelle catalog key and/or a name, the editable prompt (null: the
catalog's), and whether the user acknowledges where the provider sends
the images, with the ``destination`` text the page showed them.
AIAnnotateSettings.title: AIAnnotateSettings

AddModel.description:
A model entry to run: ``type``, its parameters and ``name``, as resolve
answers them with what ``needs`` asked filled in.
AddModel.title: AddModel

BbxGenerator.description:
The box tool's viewer on ``dataset_path``, showing the boxes the
INPUT node has; ``num_boxes`` is how many the dialog counts up to.
BbxGenerator.title: BbxGenerator

BioimageSelection.description:
A BioImage Model Zoo model ticked on the Models tab: its id or
nickname, and the voxel size typed beside it (blank: the model's own).
BioimageSelection.title: BioimageSelection

BlockwiseGenerate.description: The task YAML(s) for ``pipeline``; ``job_name`` names the task.
BlockwiseGenerate.title: BlockwiseGenerate

BlockwisePipeline.description:
The builder's pipeline, one list of nodes per node type, as the
blockwise routes read it: the first input, output and blockwise-config
node are the ones used, and the models are run on the chain the
normalizers and postprocessors make. The four lists must have a node, and
the input and output a dataset_path, checked in that order.
BlockwisePipeline.title: BlockwisePipeline

BlockwisePrecheck.description: The task YAMLs generate wrote, to check.
BlockwisePrecheck.title: BlockwisePrecheck

BlockwiseSettings.description:
The pipeline builder's blockwise settings. All three counts are
required, as whole numbers; a missing one is reported as None.
BlockwiseSettings.title: BlockwiseSettings

BlockwiseSubmit.description:
The task to submit: the YAMLs precheck passed and the name generate gave
them, or else, when none are given or they are not all there,
``pipeline``'s, generated anew. ``yaml_paths`` is a list of paths, as for
precheck.
BlockwiseSubmit.title: BlockwiseSubmit

BlockwiseTaskSettings.description:
A blockwise-config node's params: what a task and its master are
submitted with. Each is required, and taken as sent (precheck checks
the task's).
BlockwiseTaskSettings.title: BlockwiseTaskSettings

BlockwiseValidate.description: Whether ``pipeline`` is ready to run blockwise.
BlockwiseValidate.title: BlockwiseValidate

BoundingBox.description: Its lower corner and its size.
BoundingBox.title: BoundingBox

BuilderCanvas.description:
The pipeline builder's canvas as it sends it: its nodes by type, and
its edges, each a list (a missing one is empty). The dashboard keeps it
for the builder's next load, and each model node's ``config`` for a
model node that comes back without one; the chain is not read from it.
BuilderCanvas.title: BuilderCanvas

CellposeSelection.description:
A Cellpose model ticked on the Models tab's Cellpose panel: its name
(cpsam_v2, cpsam), the voxel size typed beside it, its output, whether
it segments in 3D, and for 2D masks how much two slices' masks must
overlap to be linked (IoU; blank or 0: not linked). A blank voxel size
is kept as None here, and refused by services.launch with a message
naming the model.
CellposeSelection.title: CellposeSelection

ChainNode.description: A normalizer or postprocessor node, whose params may be null for none.
ChainNode.title: ChainNode

CreateModelConfig.description:
A model type and its constructor's parameters, as the builder's model
form sends them; ``registry.build_model`` builds the config from them as
from any model entry. ``type`` is the type's name (``registry.model_types``,
"fly"); ``class_name``, the class name ("FlyModelConfig") the form posted
before 0.3.0, is still taken in its place, with a deprecation warning,
until the release after.
CreateModelConfig.title: CreateModelConfig

CreateVolume.description:
A new, empty annotation volume for ``model_name``, in a new session
under ``output_path`` (by default ~/.cellmap_flow/corrections).
CreateVolume.title: CreateVolume

Equivalences.description:
A merging postprocessor's merged ids, from its inference server, for
the segmentation layer whose source ends in ``dataset``: each list is a
set of ids shown as one.
Equivalences.title: Equivalences

FinetuneRestart.description:
The next iteration of a job: the training settings to change, each checked as
TrainingOptions checks it (``changes``; the trainer applies them, cli.apply_restart_params),
and the manifest overrides. Nothing is required: the job's model and corrections
stay as launched.

mode.description: What trains: a LoRA adapter on the frozen network (lora), every weight (full), or the network's last layer (head), which only the browser offers. A LoRA rank of 0 means full.

lora_r.description: LoRA rank; 0 is a full finetune (every parameter trainable, no adapter), which exports full_finetune/model_state_dict.pt instead of lora_adapter/. Low rank is itself the anti-forgetting mechanism: the adapter wants just enough capacity to fix the bad regions and not enough to rewrite the good ones.

lora_alpha.description: LoRA alpha, the adapter's scaling (alpha / rank); left blank it is twice the rank, so the scaling stays 2 whatever the rank.

lora_min_channels.description: Skip LoRA on layers narrower than this on either side. Narrow full-resolution layers are where the adapter is expensive and nearly parameter-free: on mito-aff-unet-setup-16, 96 skips 7 of 19 layers (~1% of adapter params) for a 1.7x faster step. 0 adapts every layer.

gradient_accumulation_steps.description: Batches to accumulate gradients over before each optimizer step.

loss_type.description: The supervised loss. 'interval' is for a distance model (output_type distance) on scribbles: each painted voxel is held between the bounds the paint implies on its distance to the boundary, exact where the paint is dense, and the field's slope is limited (slope_weight). 'flow' is for a flow model such as Cellpose (output_type flows): MSE of the flows, halved, plus BCE of the foreground, each over the voxels it can be known at.

label_smoothing.description: s moves the targets from 0 and 1 to s/2 and 1 - s/2, which keeps the model from being pushed to extreme outputs and preserves gradual, distance-like predictions. The margin, interval and flow losses take none.

distillation_lambda.description: Weight of the distillation term, which holds the model to the one it started from where the paint says nothing; 0 switches it off. Try 0.5 to 1 for sparse scribbles. Blank leaves it to the trainer: 1 when the session has good regions, else 0.

distillation_scope.description: Where the distillation term applies: the unlabeled voxels only, or all voxels. Good regions, when the session has any, decide instead.

margin.description: The margin loss's margin: foreground must exceed 1 - margin, background stay below it.

balance_classes.description: Weight foreground and background voxels equally, however many of each were painted; keeps the foreground from being over-predicted.

slope_weight.description: Weight of the interval loss's slope limit, which keeps the predicted field from getting steeper than a distance field. Without it the bounds alone let the field collapse into a step.

augment.description: Random flips, XY rotations, brightness and noise on each patch (patch-centre jitter is always applied). Augmentation pays off when a run revisits the same patches many times; below a few hundred gradient steps it mostly adds variance, which is why it is off by default.

mixed_precision.description: Mixed precision on CUDA: bf16 where the GPU has it, else fp16 with a GradScaler, falling back to fp32 when the model NaNs under either. Off on other devices.

tensorboard.description: Write TensorBoard event files to <output-dir>/tensorboard (view with `tensorboard --logdir <training dir>`).

mask_unannotated.description: Sparse annotations: only annotated voxels count in the loss (0 unannotated, 1 background, 2 and up foreground). The dashboard sets it when the session is painted.

output_type.description: The training target (TrainingOptions.output_type); blank, the route detects it from the model.

distance_sigma.description: tanh scale in output voxels of the distance target. The cellmap distance models were trained with 6.

select_channel.description: Train one channel of a multi-channel model (output_type binary only); blank trains all.

offsets.description: JSON list of [dz, dy, dx] offsets for affinity targets, e.g. '[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]]'. Blank with output_type affinities reads 'offsets' from the model script.

output_class.description: What the model's output is, as its server reports it (serving.probe): unit for a sigmoid baked in ([0, 1]), signed_unit for a tanh ([-1, 1]), unbounded for logits. The losses then compare probabilities or logits accordingly, as ranking and seeding read the same output. Blank, the training job probes the model once.

patches_per_epoch.description: Patches drawn per epoch; blank or 0 draws one per populated chunk. Kept in the session's manifest.

rehearsal_fraction.description: The share of each epoch's patches drawn from the good regions, 0 to 1; 0 turns rehearsal off without dropping the regions. Blank keeps the manifest's value.

FinetuneRestart.title: FinetuneRestart

``corrections_path``, a session's corrections directory or the base
output path of its sessions, with the training settings of
``finetune.options.TrainingOptions``, whose defaults are the server
form's (_finetune_tab.html's values and selected options, checked
against them by tests/web/test_schema.py; cellmap_flow.schema exports
them to the browser as FINETUNE_DEFAULTS). The route adjusts them for
painted annotations and for the model's target (TrainingOptions.for_session).

LoadCrops.description:
Crops imported into the session's annotation volume for ``model_name``:
``yaml`` is the YAML's text or its path, ``output_path`` as for
CreateVolume, and ``load_id`` names the import's progress.
LoadCrops.title: LoadCrops

ModelNode.description:
A model node. It may carry the config the model was defined with (its
ModelConfig.to_dict()), which stands in for params when it has none.
ModelNode.title: ModelNode

PipelineNode.description:
A node of the builder's pipeline (state.js), ``{id, name, params,
position}``, of which the routes read the name and the params.
PipelineNode.title: PipelineNode

PipelineUpdate.description:
The body of PUT /api/pipeline.

``input_norm`` and ``postprocess`` are the two chains, each a list of
``{"name": <op class>, **its parameters}`` steps in the order they run
(pipeline_spec's form). Both are required, ``[]`` for none, and every
step must name a registered op of its kind. ``builder`` is the pipeline
builder's canvas (BuilderCanvas); only the builder sends it.
PipelineUpdate.title: PipelineUpdate

RemoveModel.description:
The ✕ of a model on the Models tab's Loaded models list: the one
model to stop (services.launch.remove_model), by its name.
RemoveModel.title: RemoveModel

RequestBodies.title: RequestBodies
RequestBodies.description: The body each route parses with a pydantic model, by `METHOD path`. The routes not listed take no body or read theirs by hand.

ResolveModel.description: What the user pasted, and optionally the model's name and voxel size.
ResolveModel.title: ResolveModel

Route.description:
One route of the dashboard and where it is answered: "both", by the
Flask route and the browser's; "stub", the browser answers the server's
JSON shape with fixed or empty data; "server", the browser answers
unavailable; "browser", only the page has it. ``request`` names the
pydantic model its body is parsed with, where there is one.

path.description: Flask's spelling of the path: a parameter is <name>.

Route.title: Route

ServerConfigUpdate.description:
Any of the saved settings (jobs.settings.SERVER_CONFIG_DEFAULTS); only those
sent change. The counts must be whole numbers; the rest are kept as sent,
and keys that are not settings are ignored.
ServerConfigUpdate.title: ServerConfigUpdate

SetData.description: The dataset to open a new viewer on.
SetData.title: SetData

StepSpec.description:
A normalizer or postprocessor as the dashboard's forms list it: its
class, its name, and its constructor's parameters with their defaults
("" for one without a default).
StepSpec.title: StepSpec

SubmitModels.description:
The Models tab's Submit: the catalog models, Hugging Face repos,
BioImage Model Zoo and Cellpose models to run. Every other running model
is stopped (services.launch). ``resample``, when given, becomes the
session's (``Session.resample``) before the models are started.
SubmitModels.title: SubmitModels
